statement: Under RH and source fixed D=e=10^-4,delta=10^-6, delayed-profile grouped errors satisfy ||sum_{C in B} zeta(R_C-T_{L,w_kC}R_C)||_*² <= (C/L)sum_{C in B}(2+|tau_C|)^(-2+1/100) for every subset B, L=logN. Centers are fixed-mesh separated; individual roots need not be. The tail beyondY is O(Y^(-99/100)/L).

statement: Under the same RH inputs, withH=N^(1/20), K=N^(3/20), the source growing delayed correction is realized by an actual length-at-mostN Dirichlet polynomial. Its low/high squared zeta-weighted quadrature errors are O(N^(-0.1499595)) and O(N^(-0.049958)); the anchor is O(N^(-0.07499475)). Constants may depend on the fixed contour parameters.

For each fixed finite union of source clusters, expand its principal parts into individual Laurent terms a_(rho,j)/(s-rho)^j. Outside a fixed neighborhood of that term's own ordinate, the singleton repeated-node profile estimate bounds its zeta-multiplied error by C_F|zeta(1/2+it)|/[L|t-gamma|^(j+1)], giving weighted norm O_F(1/L). This also covers gaps inside the original full cluster hull and fills the use of26 in source§7.2.

statement: Assume RH. Thenlim_N(logN)Delta_N²=lim_N(logN)d_N²=sum_{distinct nontrivialrho}m_rho²/|rho|², counting both ordinate signs.
